item.text:
**Source Map — IMP-005 / SFP Segalmex report, 18 Aug 2022**

Source ID: IMP-005. Title: "Secretaría de la Función Pública presenta informe sobre Segalmex." Issuer: SFP (Secretaría de la Función Pública), official press comunicado disseminated on LICONSA gob.mx portal. Date: 18 Aug 2022. Type: audit_summary / executive-oversight-body communication. Audited entities: Segalmex, Liconsa, Diconsa. Period covered: 2019 (Segalmex creation) to cierre 2021, plus ongoing 2022 reviews; ASF portion tied to Cuenta Pública 2020.

**Atomic claims (observed in text):**

1. SFP opened 84 fiscalización acts (audits, visits, verifications) on Segalmex, 2019–cierre 2021, with observed amounts of 6,052.3 mdp. [block 2]
2. In 2022 SFP is running further reviews of abasto rural, abasto social de leche, precios de garantía, plus acquisitions, leases, services, inventories. [block 2]
3. ASF, reviewing Cuenta Pública 2020, issued 22 pliegos de observaciones totaling 3,465.8 mdp across the three entities. [block 3]
4. Combined SFP + ASF observed amounts ≈ 9,500 mdp; report states this "no significa que representen un daño patrimonial" because items are in clarification, documentation, or recovery. [block 3]
5. 618 administrative-responsibility investigation files open at SFP. [block 2]
6. 38 criminal complaints filed with FGR by Procuraduría Fiscal de la Federación, UIF-SHCP, SFP, and FGR itself; mainly "uso ilícito de atribuciones y facultades," framed under delincuencia organizada optics. [block 2]
7. One ex-official linked to proceso for investing 950 mdp outside normative rules; recovered. [block 2]
8. Independent audit opinions deteriorated: Liconsa limpio (2019) → abstención (2021); Diconsa salvedad (2019) → abstención (2021); Segalmex abstención sustained. [block 3]
9. Personnel dismissed at central and operational levels across the three entities; leadership changes framed as control-strengthening. [block 3]
10. Interinstitutional work group created: Gobernación, Agricultura, SFP, Procuraduría Fiscal, Oficialía Mayor SHCP. [block 1–2]
11. Stated corrective lines: internal-control strengthening, harmonization, formal state-level Segalmex offices, modernization of acopio IT, inventory controls, updated padrones. [block 3]
12. Segalmex created 2019 to support maize, bean, rice, wheat guaranteed prices. [block 4]

**Evidentiary status / qualifications:**
- 9,500 mdp is observed monto, not adjudicated daño patrimonial; figures still subject to aclaración, documentación, or recovery.
- "Presunta" corruption, "presuntos" delitos; one case confirmed via vinculación a proceso.
- Independent audit deterioration is factual reporting; root-cause analysis not provided in the extract.
- No individual sanctions beyond the one 950 mdp case and unspecified dismissals are detailed.
- No procurement-level contract IDs, beneficiary lists, or per-finding amounts are in the extract.

**Author assertions vs. observed facts:**
- Observed: numbers of audits, complaints, files, opinion changes, dismissals.
- Author assertion (SFP, Salcedo Aquino): causes framed as "desarticulación administrativa" and "presunta corrupción"; forward-looking commitments to controls. Treaty these as official position, not adjudicated.

**Limitations / reopen items:**
- No breakdown of which 22 ASF pliegos correspond to which entity or program.
- No timeline for the 38 FGR complaints; no indictment counts beyond the 950 mdp case.
- No individual identifications of dismissed personnel.
- No procurement-specific records (contracts, suppliers, conflicts of interest) — full audit and FGR records needed for 5B.5 depth.
- No delivery/output data to test 5B.6 (delivery vs. announcement).
- No discussion of budget design or policy choice, so 5B.1/5B.9 only marginally relevant.

**Sections for stronger model to reopen:** underlying SFP audit reports (84 acts), ASF Cuenta Pública 2020 individual pliegos, FGR case files, independent-audit financial statements, and procurement records.
